sources.title: Credibility assessment | De Montfort University
topics: Have researched living in the UK
Are able to provide detailed information on your financial status
sources.notes: Applies to 'applicants looking to study at our Leicester campus'. Format: 'The credibility assessment will take place on Microsoft Teams' and 'will take between 20-30 minutes' (live interviewer, not CAS Shield video). Outcome 'will be sent within 5 working days from the date of your assessment (not including weekends or UK bank holidays)'. Search snippet for the same page adds: required 'unless their country of domicile is included on the gov.uk Differential Evidence Requirement list'; arrive promptly with good Wi-Fi, in a private room, no camera filters, and bring your passport. No verbatim example questions; no stated attempt limit or fail consequences.

sources.notes: Fetch returned only Scribd's summary of the document ('responses to credibility interview questions for a student applying to study a BA in Business and Marketing at De Montfort University'); the question list itself was not readable. Topics above are inferred from the summary text, not verbatim questions.

sources.notes: Seen in search results only; title claims a CAS Shield interview at DMU, which conflicts with DMU's own page describing a Microsoft Teams assessment. Not fetched (budget).

sources.title: De Montfort University: live CAS Shield tenant (dmu.cas-shield.com)
sources.notes: Probed 8 September 2026: the subdomain answers HTTP 200 with the Enroly CAS Shield sign-in page (random subdomains answer nothing), so the university runs its CAS process through Enroly. CAS Shield interviews follow the themes in Brunel's published policy; whether this university switches the interview on for every Nepali applicant is not stated here.
